definitions.gloss: any one (of three or more); whichever
definitions.explanation: どれ (which one) + でも (even, any): any one of the things in question, it does not matter which. Used when choosing among three or more things; for two things use どちらでも.

examples.japanese: どれでも⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
どれでも⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、どれでも⟦{一個|いっこ}→一個：08922_ikko⟧{三百円|さんびゃくえん}です。
examples.english: Every cake in this shop is 300 yen each, whichever you pick.

notes:
Part of the question word + ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ family: ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (anyone), ⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (anytime), ⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (anywhere), ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (anything).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- どれでも⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: any one will do
- どれでも⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧なもの: whichever one you like
- どれでも⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: any one, it doesn't matter which

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ / ⟦どっち→どっち：02922_docchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: either one (of two)
- ⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧: every one, all of them; with a negative, none of them (⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦じゃない→じゃない：28483_janai⟧). Compare どれでも⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (any one is fine) with ⟦どれも→どれも：22934_doremo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (they are all good).
